what: Every page of the website, one file per route
merkle_algorithm: Pages sorted by route. File hash is SHA-256 of the raw page file. Leaf is SHA-256(0x00 || file hash). If a level has an odd count, the last digest is duplicated. Parent is SHA-256(0x01 || left || right). Every inclusion proof was recomputed to the root in this run.
what_a_timestamp_proves: That these page bytes existed at or before the Bitcoin time that confirms the OpenTimestamps proof. It does not prove that the words on a page are true.
bitcoin_status: Submitted 2026-11-13T02:15:43Z to four OpenTimestamps calendars: alice, bob, finney, catallaxy. Each returned a pending attestation. No Bitcoin transaction id has been issued yet. The proof file is MERKLE_ROOT.txt.ots.
pages_not_inside_this_stamp: Any page created or edited after this UTC time, including the notice that announces this stamp.
